overridableConfigKeys.label: Gated content
overridableConfigKeys.description: The trait rendered when the viewer's role is allowed, e.g. a button or panel trait ref.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: wrapped content, guarded element, protected button

overridableConfigKeys.label: Visible to roles
overridableConfigKeys.description: Roles (matched against viewerRole) that see the content. Empty = everyone; any other viewer sees nothing.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: allowed roles, only for, who can see, permitted roles

overridableConfigKeys.label: Viewer's role
overridableConfigKeys.description: The signed-in viewer's role that `roles` is checked against. Bind it explicitly at the call site (e.g. `viewerRole: @user.role`); left empty, only an ungated (empty `roles`) gate renders.

capabilities: role gate, only for roles, hide for role, permission wrapper, restrict button to role, show only to admins, role-based visibility
